top_signals.title: Qatar, Citi and PIMCO on Capital Discipline and Resilience
top_signals.summary: H.E. Ali bin Ahmed Al-Kuwari, Minister of Finance for the State of Qatar, Jane Fraser, Chair & CEO at Citi and Emmanuel Roman, CEO at PIMCO, discuss fiscal discipline, capital and economic resilience with Bloomberg’s David Gura at the Qatar Economic Forum UNGA Special Edition in New York in 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)
